ITEM 1 | Pale yellow scrambled egg pieces, soft and slightly moist with small curds and some lighter edges, heaped in a loose mound covering roughly 30% of the plate's left side, about 5 cm tall at the peak | 110
ITEM 2 | Bright red raspberries, whole and intact, scattered among the eggs with a glossy, slightly juicy surface, about 15 berries spread across roughly 8% of the plate | 60
ITEM 3 | Dark purple-black blackberries, whole with visible drupelets, mixed among the raspberries and eggs, about 5 berries covering roughly 3% of the plate | 25
ITEM 4 | Orange sweet potato cubes with browned, caramelized edges and darker charred spots, matte with slight sheen, cut into irregular chunks about 2 to 3 cm across, piled in a cluster covering roughly 20% of the right side of the plate, about 2 cm tall | 120
